title: Place props whose depth the image fakes by back-projecting their pixel
summary: Lamps, hoses, roads and tufts whose 'physical' placement hides them or sizes them wrong: unproject their reference pixel through the solved camera onto the plane they sit on (screen -> plane).

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: q.mjs x,y,axis,value: pixel (x, y) onto the plane axis = value -> world point. The dig hose ended ~1 m lower than designed; far tufts 25 m back needed ~2x size.

doc.when: After the camera is proven, for every prop the reference draws at a size/height that disagrees with its physics.
doc.avoid: Designing those props physically and then nudging by eye.
gotchas: The tool lives in docs/style-studio-critic-loop (unproj2.mjs / q.mjs); the app should offer it (screen -> plane).

problem.symptom: Solved props render out of view (lamps and a hose hidden behind a deck) or at the wrong size.
problem.cause: The image draws the space under the deck taller, distant props larger: back-projected depth disagrees with the physical design.
problem.fix: Back-project each prop's pixel onto its supporting plane and place it there.
problem.detect: Props missing or misplaced on the edge overlay.
